question: Does allowing the existing one-turn wait on mixed hiring/purchase turns expose additional profitable Otter timing?
primary: Paired final cash margin, recomputing both players trades. Also own cash.
constraints: Original worker actions and market commitments; no extra missing resources/commitment mismatch; full-engine production, labor and faults unchanged for fixed-plan claims.
forecast: Known current shops and public ready product; future rival orders unavailable to decision. Original own next-turn orders and resource calendar are given plan input.
scope: Three exposed replay plans and fixed rival orders; not unseen scenarios and not an adaptive Otter agent. Existing untuned one-turn rule may have limited coverage.
promotion: No general promotion from this cohort. Require new scenarios, diverse farm plans and reacting opponents.
change: Remove sale-only precondition, preserve existing non-sale slots, and require identical hires/workers/land after current trading in addition to existing two-turn input/end-state checks. No tuned thresholds or rival futures. Existing max one delayed product and known-demand boundary unchanged.
comparison: Compare with original and the previous sale-only results. Retain any failures; do not filter them into a success-only mean.
